access.guidance: 15 minutes by bus from JR Beppu Station. Three-minute walk from the "Beppu kokusai kankoukou Ferry Sunflower Mae" bus stop. Approx. 10 minutes by taxi from JR Beppu Station.
Approx. 15 minutes from Oita Expressway Beppu IC.

From Oita Airport Take the express bus bound for Beppu Station (Airport Express Airliner) and get off at "Beppu Kotsu Center". Route Travel time is approximately 41 minutes and the cost of a ticket is JPY1400. From there you will arrive at the terminal in 8 minutes on foot.

access.guidance: From either Suminoe Koen Station on the Yotsubashi Subway line or Cosmos Square Station on the Chuo Subway line, take the Newtram to "Trade Center Station." The terminal is a five-minute walk away. Osaka Municipal Subway

From Osaka City Take the "Nanko Kita" exit on the Hanshin Expressway Wangan Line. The terminal is a ten-minute drive away. From Kansai International Airport Take the "Nanko Minami" exit on the Hanshin Expressway Wangan Line.The terminal is a 15-minute drive away.

From Kansai International Airport Take the limousine bus bound for Osaka Nanko and get off at "Hyatt Regency Osaka". Please click here for timetable.
